column1: # The theme selects the color scheme that every light-dark() semantic role
# resolves against. `ds-check theme` enforces that packages/styles/tokens/theme.css
# implements exactly these rows, that no other Design System stylesheet sets
# color-scheme, and that the theme declares no custom property.
#   default    the `color-scheme` value on :root when no hook value applies.
#              `light dark` follows the user's OS or browser preference.
#   attribute  the one public hook, an attribute on the root element. Each
#              Any other value, or no attribute, keeps the default.
# Classes follow tokens.tsv: public-preview until a reviewed contract earns
